“Ungoogled Chromium”官方下载（ChromePublic_arm64.apk）：<br>
<a rel="nofollow noopener" href="https://github.com/ungoogled-software/ungoogled-chromium-android/releases/latest" target="_blank">https://github.com/ungoogled-sof ... oid/releases/latest</a><br>
<br>
<br>
“uBO Lite”（uBlock Origin Lite）扩展官网：<br>
<a rel="nofollow noopener" href="https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/ublock-origin-lite/ddkjiahejlhfcafbddmgiahcphecmpfh" target="_blank">https://chromewebstore.google.co ... afbddmgiahcphecmpfh</a><br>
<br>
<br>
【<strong>操作步骤</strong>】“Ungoogled Chromium”安装“uBO Lite”的crx扩展<br>
<br>
1.运行“Ungoogled Chromium”应用，点上方的扩展图标按钮，再点“管理扩展程序”。<br>
<img id="aimg_XeB06" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://s41.ax1x.com/2026/10/21/pnBekzq.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://s41.ax1x.com/2026/10/21/pnBekzq.png"><br>
<br>
2.开启“开发者模式”，点“load .crx”，选择手机里的crx扩展文件例如“uBOLite_2026_1018_2229_0.crx”。<br>
<img id="aimg_hZ244" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://s41.ax1x.com/2026/10/21/pnBeiJs.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://s41.ax1x.com/2026/10/21/pnBeiJs.png"><br>
<br>
3.等待10秒左右中间显示了“uBlock Origin Lite”扩展界面，关闭“开发者模式”，手动强制启用（重新启用）“uBlock Origin Lite”扩展。<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;之后运行“Ungoogled Chromium”应用，只需等待2秒左右就进入浏览主界面了，很有效率。<br>
<img id="aimg_B23Bl" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://s41.ax1x.com/2026/10/21/pnBeFWn.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://s41.ax1x.com/2026/10/21/pnBeFWn.png"><br>
<br>
<br>
